experiment: T9 -- do energy-error spikes track high-lambda1 regions?
status: proposed (UNCERTIFIED) -- grader inspects artifacts, not this summary

xi_convention.meaning: normalized squared per-step energy error (EEVPD-style proxy); additive 1e-8 floor
xi_convention.sentinel_note: OLD -1.0 sentinel removed (mclmc.py comment lines 327-333); results-phase xi has no -1 and no non-finite (nonan all-True). Values at the 1e-8 floor (~near-zero energy change) are excluded as a safeguard.

alignment.positions: arrays.npz samples_z (C, R, dim) = RESULTS ONLY
alignment.xi: diagnostics.npz xi (C, 40000) = burnin(20000)+results(20000); results xi = last 20000 columns
alignment.index_map: position index k <-> results-xi index k (1:1); xi[k] reflects the (k-1)->k move; +/-1 ambiguity immaterial after RMS smoothing

standardization.note: SAME as E1/T8: zhat=z/std_z (per-coordinate ddof=1 over pooled results positions); M_zhat = gn_metric(scale_cols(J_z, std_z), W); lambda1 = top eigenvalue of M_zhat.

sampling.strata: top decile / 40-60th pct / bottom decile of pooled xi_s

prediction.text: Spearman rho > 0.5 AND median lambda1 top/bottom xi-decile >= 3x

falsifier.text: rho < 0.2 OR decile ratio ~ 1 => the step-size/energy-error account is wrong

verdict_fields.T9_xi_tracks_lambda1: proposed (UNCERTIFIED): compare spearman_rho_all and decile_ratio_top_over_bottom to the prediction/falsifier; read the scatter + trace plots.
verdict_fields.note: this script does NOT adjudicate; a grader inspects plots + numbers.
